gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: All candidates used grayscale pixels and exact-hash fixed actors in a Linux CPU local diagnostic, but no official package validation was conducted.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Four independent directions changed actions on both TRAIN cells: speed envelope 140/135, exit burst 64/62, approach brake 2/4, and outer entry 19/7 decisions. All five arms finished both cells without invalid actions.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: The two-cell consumed TRAIN screen cannot establish a submission-candidate improvement. A preregistered fresh tune batch is required before comparing completion and lap time.
